hero.title: Central Tiffin Room: A Century of Timeless Taste
hero.subtitle: For over a century, Central Tiffin Room has been 'The Emotion That Holds Old Bengaluru Together,' serving Bengaluru's Best Benne Dose and timeless South Indian delicacies.

about.title: Central Tiffin Room: Our Storied Journey
about.paragraph1: CTR, affectionately known as Central Tiffin Room, is a legendary hotel steeped deeply in the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru. Incepted in 1920, we have been delighting patrons for over a century with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of South Indian delicacies, which have remained timeless favorites among people of all ages. Central Tiffin Room's rich legacy, crafted by the visionary Subramanyam brothers, Mr. Sanjeev Poojari to the current 3rd Generation baton carriers Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari, epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition in all its glory.
about.paragraph2: If there’s one thing that mirrors the Central Tiffin Room brand, it is the sheer love of our patrons who have been showering us with boundless love and support for the last 100+ years. We are proudly 'Bengaluru’s Best Benne Dose – The emotion that holds Old Bengaluru together with the essence of nostalgia in every bite.' This 104-year-old eatery has truly cast its vintage charm by delivering the most delicious Benne Doses to the old town of Bengaluru, retaining the same authentic taste all along the way.
